'''Khungata''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWI 135">{{InsiderCite|135|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Ewoks: Warriors of Endor!}}</ref> The Ewok was part of the group that captured [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and their companions shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Yub Yub">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref>
